summary: A recent deployment (v1.1.0) introduced a KeyError in checkout-api when accessing a missing 'currency' field in pricing context, causing 5xx errors. Rolling back to v1.0.0 removes the faulty code.

timeline.description: Deploy v1.1.0 added currency context code
First KeyError observed in checkout-api logs

next_steps: Monitor checkout-api error rate after rollback
Validate that KeyError no longer occurs in logs
Review pricing service tests for currency handling

proposed_actions.reason: KeyError due to missing currency in request context
